verdict.rationale: Pulumi's first-party agent, Neo, takes plain-English requests ("Tell Neo what you need in plain English"; example prompt "Give me a VPC with a subnet in every AZ"), then handles dependencies, executes changes and monitors outcomes. Its MCP server and agent skills also let coding assistants such as Claude Code and Cursor operate Pulumi conversationally and delegate tasks to Neo. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed, and in-depth docs on Neo's command scope and limits beyond marketing-level descriptions.
